note: Forbidden: a rejected pair answered with anything but a PAP Code 3. TestPAPRejectWritesNak (accept=false) asserts payload[0]==PAPAuthenticateNak; TestPAPRequestEmitsEvent asserts the accept path sends Ack, so an unconditional Nak goes red. The SHOULD-terminate half of the sentence is RFC1334-2.3-5 and is not claimed here.
